en-s01-1.text: Hi! I'm Emma. What's your name?

en-s01-10.text: Thank you. You are very kind.

en-s01-2.text: Hello, Emma. My name is Paul.

en-s01-5.text: Are you a friend of Tom?

en-s01-6.text: Yes, I am. We work together.

en-s02-1.text: Excuse me, is this seat free?

en-s02-2.text: Yes, it is. Please sit down.

en-s02-4.text: I'm from France. I live in Lyon.

en-s02-6.text: And you? Where do you live?

en-s02-7.text: I live in Edinburgh, but I'm from Ireland.

en-s02-9.text: No, it isn't very big, but it's beautiful.

en-s03-3.text: That's my husband, Mark. And these are my children.

en-s03-5.text: My son is ten and my daughter is seven.

en-s03-7.text: No, I haven't. But I've got two sisters.

en-s04-2.text: I'm an engineer. I work for a car company.

en-s04-3.text: Interesting! Do you like your job?

en-s04-4.text: Yes, I do. And what about you?

en-s04-5.text: I'm a teacher. I teach maths in a school.

en-s04-7.text: From Monday to Friday. I start at eight.

en-s04-9.text: Yes, but I finish at four.

en-s05-1.text: What do you do at the weekend?

en-s05-2.text: I like playing tennis and reading.

en-s05-3.text: Me too! I play tennis on Saturdays.

en-s05-5.text: In the park near the station.

en-s05-6.text: Do you want to play with us?

en-s06-1.text: Excuse me, where is the British Museum, please?

en-s06-2.text: Go straight on and turn left at the bank.

en-s06-3.text: Turn left at the bank. Is it far?

en-s06-4.text: No, it's about five minutes on foot.

en-s06-5.text: It's next to a big bookshop.

en-s06-6.text: Is there a café near the museum?

en-s06-7.text: Yes, there's one opposite the entrance.

en-s07-1.text: Hello. Does this bus go to the airport?

en-s07-2.text: Yes, it does. Single or return?

en-s07-3.text: A return ticket, please. How much is it?

en-s07-8.text: About forty minutes. I'll tell you when we arrive.

en-s08-1.text: Good evening. Can I help you?

en-s08-2.text: Good evening. I have a reservation. My name is Martin.

en-s08-3.text: Yes, Mr Martin. A double room for two nights.

en-s08-5.text: Yes, it's from seven to ten in the restaurant.

en-s08-6.text: Can I have the Wi-Fi password, please?

en-s08-7.text: Here you are. Your room is on the third floor.

en-s08-9.text: Yes, just behind you. Have a nice stay!

en-s09-1.text: Hello, are you looking for something?

en-s09-2.text: Yes, I'm looking for a jumper.

en-s09-4.text: Medium, I think. How much is this blue one?

en-s09-7.text: Of course. The changing rooms are over there.

en-s09-9.text: Great. Would you like a bag?

en-s10-1.text: Hi there! What can I get you?

en-s10-4.text: Large, please. And could I have a croissant?

en-s10-5.text: Sorry, we haven't got any croissants left. We've got muffins.

en-s10-7.text: To eat in or take away?

en-s10-8.text: To eat in. How much is that?

en-s11-1.text: So, what's a normal day for you?

en-s11-2.text: I get up at seven and I have a shower.

en-s11-3.text: Do you have breakfast at home?

en-s11-4.text: No, I usually have a coffee at work.

en-s11-5.text: How do you go to work?

en-s11-6.text: I go by bike. It takes twenty minutes.

en-s11-8.text: I cook dinner and I watch TV. My husband reads.

en-s12-1.text: Hi Rachel, can we meet next week?

en-s12-2.text: Sure. Are you free on Tuesday?

en-s12-3.text: Sorry, I'm busy on Tuesday. What about Wednesday?

en-s12-7.text: In my office, on the second floor.

en-s13-2.text: It was great, thanks. I was in Cambridge.

en-s13-4.text: Yes, we were three. The weather was lovely.

en-s13-6.text: No, it wasn't. The hotel was cheap.

en-s13-7.text: And you? What about your weekend?

en-s13-8.text: It was quiet. I was at home all weekend.

en-s14-2.text: Yes, it's very cold. And it's raining again.

en-s14-3.text: What's the weather like in France now?

en-s14-4.text: In the south it's sunny and warm.

en-s14-5.text: Lucky you! Is it often sunny in Lyon?

en-s14-6.text: In summer, yes. But winter is cold.

en-s14-7.text: Look, the sun is coming out!

en-s14-8.text: Finally! I haven't got an umbrella.

en-s15-1.text: Good morning, Smith and Partners. How can I help you?

en-s15-2.text: Hello, this is Paul Martin. Can I speak to Mr Wilson, please?

en-s15-3.text: I'm sorry, he's in a meeting at the moment.

en-s15-5.text: This afternoon, after three. Can I take a message?

en-s15-6.text: Yes, please. Can he call me back?

en-s16-1.text: Hello, please sit down. What's the matter?

en-s16-2.text: I've got a headache and a sore throat.

en-s16-7.text: It's just a cold. Drink a lot of water and rest.

en-s16-9.text: Take these tablets twice a day.

en-s17-1.text: Tom, would you like to come for dinner on Friday?

en-s17-2.text: I'd love to, but I'm working late on Friday.

en-s17-3.text: Oh, what a pity. What about Saturday?

en-s17-7.text: Just bring a dessert if you want.

en-s17-8.text: No problem. See you on Saturday!

en-s18-1.text: Good evening. Are you ready to order?

en-s18-10.text: Of course. I'll bring it right away.

en-s18-2.text: Yes. I'd like the fish and chips, please.

en-s18-4.text: No, thank you. Is there any vegetarian food for my friend?

en-s18-5.text: Yes, there's a mushroom pie. It's very good.

en-s18-9.text: Could we have the bill, please?

en-s19-1.text: Excuse me, I'm sorry, but there's a problem with my room.

en-s19-3.text: The shower doesn't work and there isn't any hot water.

en-s19-4.text: I'm very sorry. What's your room number?

en-s19-6.text: I can't send a plumber tonight. Can you change rooms?

en-s19-8.text: Here's the key for room three hundred and five.

en-s20-1.text: What are you going to do this summer?

en-s20-2.text: I'm going to visit Scotland with my wife.

en-s20-3.text: Wonderful! How long are you going to stay?

en-s20-4.text: Two weeks. We're going to rent a car.

en-s20-5.text: Are you going to see Loch Ness?

en-s20-6.text: Yes! And we're going to walk in the mountains.

en-s20-7.text: Take a warm jacket. It's often cold there.

en-s20-8.text: Good idea. And you? Any plans?

en-s20-9.text: I'm going to stay at home and relax!
